# `smelt.prompt_bar.top`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Availability:** Terminal UI only; raises in headless mode.

The rule above the prompt, which holds the working indicator, model, tokens and cost. Register named sources with `smelt.prompt_bar.top.add(name, handler)`, or replace a built-in one by reusing its name. `add` returns a `Reg` that removes the source. UiHost-only.

## `smelt.prompt_bar.top.add`

```lua
fun(name: string, handler: fun(): smelt.bar.Item[]?): smelt.Reg
```

Types: [`smelt.bar.Item`](types.md#smeltbaritem), [`smelt.Reg`](types.md#smeltreg)

Add a named source of items to the rule of the bar above the prompt.
`handler` runs on every repaint and returns a list of items (see
`smelt.bar.Item`); errors are reported on stderr and skip the source. The
built-in sources are `pause`, `indicator`, `elapsed`, `retry`, `model`,
`tokens` and `cost`; adding one of those names replaces it in place, keeping
its position. Returns a `Reg` that removes this source, unless a later `add`
with the same name has replaced it.

## `smelt.prompt_bar.top.builtin`

```lua
fun(name: string): (fun(): smelt.bar.Item[]?)?
```

Types: [`smelt.bar.Item`](types.md#smeltbaritem)

The built-in source registered under `name` (`pause`, `indicator`,
`elapsed`, `retry`, `model`, `tokens` or `cost`), or nil. A replacement
source can call it to keep the default for the cases it does not draw.

## `smelt.prompt_bar.top.invalidate`

```lua
fun()
```

Repaint after plugin-owned state changes that are not represented by a
built-in signal. Adding, replacing, and removing sources invalidates
automatically.

## `smelt.prompt_bar.top.invalidate_after`

```lua
fun(ms: integer)
```

Repaint after `ms` milliseconds. An animated source calls it on every paint
to ask for its next frame; the earliest pending request wins.

## `smelt.prompt_bar.top.remove`

```lua
fun(name: string)
```

Remove every source named `name` from the bar above the prompt.
